authority.english: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare
authority.name: 厚生労働省

lines.label: Authority
lines.value: 厚生労働省 (Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare)

lines.label: Second authority
lines.value: 独立行政法人 医薬品医療機器総合機構 (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency, PMDA), https://www.pmda.go.jp/

lines.label: Register
lines.value: 医療用医薬品 添付文書等情報検索

lines.label: What it holds
lines.value: A PMDA search of package inserts and related documents for prescription medicines, such as patient guides, review reports and risk management plans.

lines.label: Authorisation
lines.value: Under the PMD Act a drug may not be shipped to the Japanese market without permission and approval from the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare or the prefectures; PMDA carries out the approval review, and some drugs with established safety are approved by prefectural governors.

lines.label: Scheme
lines.value: GS1 GTIN (特定用符号 under PMD Act Article 68-2-5)

lines.label: Rule
lines.value: Required for prescription medicines shipped from 1 December 2022. Dispensing packs carry a GTIN-13 used as a 14-digit code with a leading 0; sales packs use GTIN-14 with indicator digit 1 and outer cases GTIN-14 with indicator digit 2. Carriers are GS1 DataBar Limited (or its CC-A composite with lot and expiry) on dispensing and sales packs and GS1-128 on outer cases. Sales packs must also encode expiry and lot. Each marketing company assigns its own GTINs and may not reuse a discontinued one.
